context.snippet:
Diamondback Energy reports higher third-quarter earnings, increases its dividend, and raises its 2026 production forecast as Permian Basin operations generate strong cash flow.
Oilprice.com Diamondback Energy Raises Dividend and 2026 Oil Production Outlook Charles Kennedy Mon, November 2, 2026 at 9:11 PM CST 3 min read - FANG\ \ -4.71% - CL=F\ \ +0.19% - NG=F\ \ +0.84% Diamondback Energy has raised its dividend and increased its full-year oil production forecast after reporting stronger third-quarter earnings and generating more than $2.1 billion in free cash flow from its Permian Basin operations. The Midland, Texas-based oil and gas producer reported net income attributable to the company of $1.6 billion, or $5.69 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2026. That compares with $1.02 billion, or $3.51 per share, in the same period last year. Total revenue climbed to $5.43 billion from $3.92 billion a year earlier, while adjusted net income reached $1.65 billion, equivalent to $5.86 per diluted share. Diamondback generated $2.6 billion in operating cash flow during the quarter and reported $2.15 billion in free cash flow, a non-GAAP measure calculated using operating cash flow before working capital changes. The company increased its quarterly base dividend by 7.3% to $1.18 per share, bringing its annualized payout to $4.72 per share, an 18% increase from a year earlier. Diamondback also repurchased approximately 1.35 million shares for $251 million during the quarter, bringing total capital returned to shareholders to $582 million.
